defect.synthesized_guarantee: Keep your three free channels if you upgrade from the Free plan

contradicting_source_evidence.claim: When upgrading from the Free plan to a paid plan, users pay for every connected channel, including channels they had on the Free plan, because paid plans give unlimited usage and advanced features for all connected channels
contradicting_source_evidence.verbatim: If you decide to upgrade to a paid plan, you will pay for each channel — including any channels you had while on the Free plan. This is because paid plans offer unlimited usage and advanced features for all channels you've connected to Buffer.
